title: dependency-depmap-chronos — result payload schema
description: Result payload for dependency-depmap-chronos. One evidence.json per (gene, indication, subtype). The 'indication' is mapped from DepMap cell-line lineage; 'subtype' may stratify by mutation context (e.g., KRAS-mut vs WT lineage subset) when the indication config provides it.

not.$comment: Mutual exclusion (Finding A): a gene cannot be both pan-cancer-essential (broadly essential across >80% of lineages) AND lineage-selective (selectively essential in THIS lineage). This 'not' matches only when both keys are present and both true, so it rejects that contradiction while leaving all other combinations — including is_pan_cancer_essential absent, the common case — valid.

chronos_score_median.description: Median Chronos score across cell lines in the indication-mapped subset. Negative values indicate essentiality; -1 is a common 'common essential' threshold.

chronos_score_mean.description: Mean Chronos score (alternative summary; median is preferred).

chronos_score_n_lines.description: Number of cell lines contributing to the indication-subset summary.

lineage_selectivity_zscore.description: Z-score of this lineage's median vs the pan-cancer median. More negative = more selectively essential in this lineage.

is_lineage_selective_dependency.description: Convenience: chronos_score_median < -0.5 AND lineage_selectivity_zscore < -1.5. Threshold matches DepMap's 'lineage-selective' calls.

is_pan_cancer_essential.description: Convenience: gene is essential across most lineages (chronos_score_median < -1 in >80% of lineages). Suggests broad toxicity risk. NOTE: this is a GENE-LEVEL rollup (>80% of ALL lineages) surfaced in a per-(gene,indication,subtype) payload — it cannot be recomputed from the fields present here. Follow-up: move to a gene-level sidecar product. Until then it is mutually exclusive with is_lineage_selective_dependency (see top-level 'not' constraint): a gene cannot be both broadly essential everywhere AND selectively essential in this lineage.

top_codependencies.description: Top-N co-essential genes by Pearson correlation across the cell-line subset. Useful for paralog and pathway-redundancy detection.

partner_hgnc_id.description: HGNC ID of the co-dependency partner, or null. DepMap's co-essentiality universe includes pseudogenes and readthrough loci that lack a registered HGNC ID; those partners set this to null rather than failing validation. When present it must match ^HGNC:[0-9]+$.

by_mutation_context.description: OPTIONAL — sub-summaries by mutation context within the indication (e.g., KRAS-mut vs WT). Keys are mutation-context slugs; values are objects with chronos_score_median, n_lines.
